shortlist.information_argument: Even with a fixed attendee count, two assignments of shirt sizes can produce different Medium-subset counts. Thus the historical count alone is not generally sufficient. This is a logical statement, not a model failure or actual snapshot result.
shortlist.potential_positive_control: A separately requested complete event registration roster containing attendee identity and shirt size could support filtering and counting. It would be a researcher-constructed history, not information originally returned by question 1371. Its semantics and provenance must be reviewed independently.
open_semantic_gates: Whether participants are unique members or attendance records; repeated attendance rows must not silently define the answer.
Whether the event name identifies one event or multiple occurrences and which occurrences the question means.
Whether orphan or NULL member links exist: the historical SQL counts links without joining member, while the current SQL joins member.
Whether missing/NULL shirt sizes are simply not Medium and whether requested size is a current member attribute or event-time preference.
Whether a constructed roster is complete, preserves needed identities/multiplicity and handles empty results.
